Class ChronologyStoreExporter

java.lang.Object
network.ike.knowledge.provider.ChronologyStoreExporter
All Implemented Interfaces:
network.ike.knowledge.spi.KnowledgeExporter, network.ike.knowledge.spi.KnowledgeService<network.ike.knowledge.spi.ExportRequest, network.ike.knowledge.spi.ExportResult>
public final class ChronologyStoreExporter extends Object implements network.ike.knowledge.spi.KnowledgeExporter
Exports a knowledge set's change-set artifact from its ledger source — the chronology-store KnowledgeExporter: discovers the KnowledgeSetSource, replays the composed session into a fresh in-memory store, exports the store by real time (which excludes the store's startup sentinel stamp), and optionally extracts the koncept definitions from the same materialized store — one materialization, both artifacts.

The view specification's export dimensions are honored by the resolver increment (IKE-Network/ike-issues#849); this provider currently exports the whole set, matching the behavior the deprecated seam main established.
